reference.adaptation: Same original-pixel verified material classes. Noisy reference thinning becomes deterministic density scaling through our existing seeded candidates. Full bare corners suppress flowers/dry tufts rather than leaving 3% residue; existing snow/sand/litter rules remain unchanged.

generation.policy: An exact original 512x512 RGBA8 no-mip fingerprint is required; unknown/modified art, unsupported dimensions and disputed whole slots have no additional rules. No texture bytes are embedded.

design.snapshot: 64-byte per-atlas immutable corner-mask payload, decoded once during optional cover preparation; no new shader, streamed object or per-frame update. Eight-atlas sample maps retain 512 bytes before Dictionary overhead.
design.coordinates: Use existing actual triangle/rotation-aware hit UV, reverse the decoded image V flip, remove original 8-pixel gutter from each 64-pixel slot and bilinearly interpolate NW/NE/SE/SW bare corners.
design.dry_cover: Flowers/dry tufts on ground types0/5/11 multiply by 1-smoothstep(.30,.75,bare_share). Flower footprint also rejects edges over.75 bare share. No new random stream.
design.beaches: Existing sand type3 OR a verified atlas slot with any sand-family corner; existing admitted ground types, sea habitat, dry/slope/scenery/full footprint checks remain. Mound soft-sand metadata remains separate.

acceptance.comparison_scope: Native/script scans use actual maps with empty scenery exclusions. Render tests separately load complete authored World/Map/scenery; isolate flower/shell geometry. Counterfactual before images disable only family masks within the same candidate pack.
acceptance.render_controls: On each of Compatibility/Mobile/Forward+, local flower count10->7, shell count13->14; visible changes and byte-exact per-renderer family-mask restoration. Existing meadow/shell fixtures also pass pause, pressure, shadow refresh, snapshot release, rebuild and option-off restoration. No whole mixed-cover/device acceptance claimed.
